lead: Markets, nativity scenes, concerts and thousands of lights. Discover everything Valencia has in store for the festive season.

Valencia celebrates Christmas with a unique blend of Mediterranean tradition and visual spectacle. The streets of the centre become a trail of light, the markets smell of nougat and orange, and the whole city invites you to stroll and celebrate.
We have gathered the best Christmas plans in Valencia, from free family activities to unique food experiences and unmissable concerts.

items.title: The big Christmas tree and the traditional market
items.body: The heart of Valencian Christmas. The monumental tree lights up the square, alongside dozens of stalls selling crafts, nougat, nativity figurines and typical seasonal products.

items.title: Lights trail: Valencia lit up
items.body: More than 800,000 lights decorate the streets of the historic centre. An evening stroll along Colón, Paz and Xàtiva to enjoy the spectacle of light and colour as a family.

items.title: Monumental nativity scene and Christmas science exhibition
items.body: Every year the Museu de les Ciències hosts a large-scale nativity scene and an interactive exhibition on the physical phenomena behind the magic of Christmas.

items.title: Christmas at Bioparc: Santa’s Safari
items.body: The animals at Bioparc dress up for the holidays. Santa tours the park on a special safari, children can hand him their letter and take part in animal workshops.

items.title: Workshop on Valencian Christmas nougat and sweets
items.body: Learn to make Xixona nougat, sugared almonds and mantecados with master artisans from the Central Market. A food experience that lets you take the taste of Christmas home.

items.title: Christmas concert: Valencia Children’s Choir
items.body: The Generalitat Valenciana’s Children’s Choir gives its annual Christmas concert, with traditional carols and classical pieces, at the emblematic Palau de la Música.

blocks.title: Tips for Christmas in Valencia
items: The lights are switched on on 28 November
The markets are open from 10:00 to 21:00
Book the workshops in advance, they fill up fast
The Three Kings parade is on 5 January
Public transport is free on Christmas Eve
The weather in December is mild, between 10 and 17 °C
